title: AssetEntry
description: One entry of an Extension's `assets` list: a first-class AssetType, or a constructor-bound AssetBinding. An `AssetType` carries its own stable identity, identity hooks, source codec and factory provider, and is the form new types should take. An `AssetBinding` binds a handler to a runtime constructor instead, and is what the built-in types still use.
